app.name: Malawi Health AI
app.tagline: Yang'ana zizindikiro. Peza chithandizo. Khalani wathanzi.

hero.eyebrow: Unduna wa Zaumoyo · Chithandizo cha AI
hero.subtitle: Lowetsani zizindikiro zanu ndi kupeza chithandizo cha AI mwamsanga. Mu Chingerezi kapena Chichewa, pa foni iliyonse — palibe pulogalamu yofunika.

how.label: Mmene zimagwira
how.title: Masitepe atatu a chithandizo
how.subtitle: Zopangidwira kumveka bwino ndi mwachangu pa chipangizo chilichonse.
how.step1_desc: Sankhani m'ndandanda wa zizindikiro zodziwika bwino mu Chingerezi kapena Chichewa.
how.step2_desc: Modeli yathu imayerekeza zizindikiro zanu ndi mitundu ya matenda 11 ofunika kwambiri ku Malawi.
how.step3_desc: Onani matenda otheka ndi kukhulupirika kwake, pamodzi ndi malangizo a kupewa ndi chisamaliro.

diseases.label: Kufikira kwa matenda
diseases.title: Yophunzitsidwa pa matenda ofunika ku Malawi
diseases.subtitle: Modeli yotsimikizika pa matenda omwe ali ndi vuto lalikulu m'dziko.
diseases.note: Zotsatira ndi chitsogozo chabe ndipo sizilowa m'malo mwa kuyeza kwa dokotala.

ussd.label: Njira zambiri
ussd.title: Mulibe smartphone? Palibe vuto.
ussd.subtitle: Imbani nambala ya USSD pa foni iliyonse kuti mugwiritse ntchito ntchito yomweyi — palibe intaneti, palibe data, palibe pulogalamu.
ussd.feature1: Imagwira pa netiweki iliyonse ya GSM

features.label: Zomwe dongosolo limatha
features.title: Zopangidwira Malawi
features.ai_desc: Yophunzitsidwa pa zizindikiro za matenda ofunika ku Malawi pogwiritsa ntchito XGBoost, SVM, ndi Random Forest.
features.channels_desc: Ogwiritsa smartphone amapeza mawonekedwe a web. Ogwiritsa foni wamba amaimba nambala.
features.language_desc: Kuthandizira kwathunthu Chingerezi ndi Chichewa, ndi mawu a zachipatala kuchokera m'mabuku.
features.security_desc: Zizindikiro sizigawidwa. Maakaunti osasankha amasunga mbiri motetezeka pansi pa lamulo la Data Protection Act.

final_cta.title: Muli wokonzeka kuyang'ana zizindikiro?
final_cta.subtitle: Zimatenga mphindi imodzi yokha. Kwaulere, kwachinsinsi, mu chilankhulo chanu.

step1.title: Mukumva bwanji?
step1.subtitle: Sankhani zizindikiro zonse zomwe muli nazo tsopano.

step2.title: Zambiri za inu
step2.subtitle: Izi zimathandiza kuti tipeze zotsatira zolondola.
step2.duration: Muli ndi zizindikirozi kwa nthawi yayitali bwanji?

step3.title: Onaninso mayankho anu
step3.subtitle: Onetsetsani kuti zonse zili bwino tisanayambe.

result.title: Matenda otheka
result.disclaimer: Uku si kuyeza kwa dokotala. Ngati zizindikiro zili zowopsa, funsani chithandizo mwamsanga.
result.signin_nudge_desc: Pangani akaunti yaulere kuti musunge mbiri ya kuyang'ana kwanu ndi kuyang'anira mmene zikuyendera.

about.title: Za dongosolo ili
about.intro: Malawi Health AI ndi pulojekiti ya maphunziro yomwe imagwiritsa ntchito makina ophunzira kuthandiza kuzindikira matenda kutengera zizindikiro, ndi malangizo a kupewa opangidwira Malawi.
about.mission: Kupanga chithandizo cha thanzi choyambirira chopezeka kwa Mmalawi aliyense — kaya amagwiritsa ntchito smartphone kapena foni wamba.
about.tech_body: Dongosolo limagwiritsa ntchito mitundu itatu ya makina ophunzira — XGBoost, Random Forest, ndi Support Vector Machine.
about.disclaimer: Dongosolo ili sililowa m'malo mwa chithandizo cha akatswiri a zaumoyo.

footer.disclaimer: Si kuyeza kwa dokotala. Nthawi zonse funsani wothandizira wa zaumoyo woyenerera.
